voice.cannot: This phone can't recognise {language} on the phone itself, so the mic doesn't work here. You can type instead.
voice.dictation_not_add_keyboard_dictati: Dictation isn't on this {device} yet. Add a keyboard with dictation on in Settings › General › Keyboard › Keyboards, wait for its language to download, then try again.
voice.dictation_not_available_right_try: Dictation isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.
voice.dictation_stopped_tap_mic_start: Dictation stopped: {why} Tap the mic to start again.
voice.downloading: This phone is getting {language} for dictation. The mic works once it's ready, in a minute or two.
voice.microphone_off_tafs_turn_settings: The microphone is off for tafs. Turn it on in Settings › tafs › Microphone.
voice.no_microphone: Allow tafs to use the microphone to dictate. Your voice becomes text on this phone and isn't sent anywhere.
voice.not_on_device: This phone can't recognise speech on the phone itself, so the mic doesn't work here: your voice would have to leave it. You can type instead.
voice.puts_message_box_back: Puts the message box back as it was.
voice.speech_recognition_not_available_l: Speech recognition isn't available for this language.
voice.speech_recognition_off_tafs_turn: Speech recognition is off for tafs. Turn it on in Settings › Privacy & Security › Speech Recognition.
voice.speech_recognition_restricted_devi: Speech recognition is restricted on this device, so dictation can't run.
voice.stopped: Dictation stopped. Tap the mic to start again.
voice.tafs_turns_your_voice_into: tafs turns your voice into text on this device. Your voice isn't sent anywhere.
voice.title: Dictation
voice.voice_becomes_text_device_not: Your voice becomes text on this device. It isn't sent until you send it.
voice.what_you_said_stays_message: What you said stays in the message box, unsent.
